realProductBugFixed: Actuals tab (src/components/app/tabs/ActualsTab.tsx) compared an overhead-inclusive estimated margin/cost against an overhead-EXCLUSIVE actual margin/cost, making every logged job look more profitable than it really was. Fixed: actual costs now apply the project's own saved overheadPercent before the comparison. New Playwright test added (tests/e2e/pro/actuals.spec.ts) asserting the corrected dollar and percent figures.
documentationErrorsFixed: The verification package's Footing-calculator examples used a wrong simplified default-selling-price formula (a generic area*$12/sqft placeholder) instead of the real production fallback ProjectCalculatorIsland.tsx uses when marketRatePerSqft is 0. Corrected the generator script and regenerated - real default margin is +13.36%, not the -113.63% the earlier (wrong) numbers showed. This was a documentation bug, not a product bug.
Scenario Compare Example 2 omitted its underlying cost inputs, making the stated true-cost figure unreproducible by a reader. Added.
fourthPassRemediation.minorClarityFix: Renamed the hourly-labor 'Hours' field to 'Job duration (hrs)' with a hint, to reduce ambiguity with per-person-hours (src/components/app/LaborCostInput.tsx)
fourthPassRemediation.openDecisionNotActioned: Blocking (not just warning) validation on invalid/blank cost fields, and grouped multi-job historical worked examples for Actuals, were both raised again by this review round. Not implemented this pass - flagged back to the user as a scope decision (the third pass deliberately chose non-blocking warnings over full blocking validation across every cost field in the app).

fifthPassUserSuppliedTestSheet.trigger: user supplied an independently-authored 140-case test spreadsheet (10 cases per tool x 14 tools) with pre-computed expected results
fifthPassUserSuppliedTestSheet.method: Every case executed directly against the real production functions (src/lib/calc.ts, src/lib/estimateMath.ts) via tests/oracle/runUserTestSheet.ts - not re-derived by hand.
fifthPassUserSuppliedTestSheet.realBugFound: ActualsTab.tsx summed actualLaborCost/actualMaterialCost/actualEquipmentCost/actualOtherCost with NO clamping at all (not even the safeD()-style clamp-negative-to-zero every other numeric field in the app has) - a negative actual cost silently reduced the true cost and inflated the reported margin (e.g. one test case: 95% instead of a realistic ~57%). Fixed: exported safe() from calc.ts, applied it to those 4 fields plus actualQuantityYd3/actualLaborHours in ActualsTab.tsx and its historical aggregation. New Playwright test added.
modelMismatchesFound: The 6 free calculator pages hardcode overheadPercent=15 and targetMarginPercent=30 as non-editable constants (ProjectCalculatorIsland.tsx) - many test rows assumed these were adjustable inputs on those pages, which they are not; the underlying formula was still verified correct with those values.

The free 'Concrete Estimate Template' tool (EstimateTemplateIsland.tsx) has no quantity field per line at all - each line is a label + single dollar amount, summed directly. Test rows assuming a qty*price-per-line model don't match any real input in that tool.
Pro Estimates/Projects/Templates have no 'fixed extra yd3' allowance mode (only percentage allowance exists) - 3 test rows exercised this nonexistent input.
